Most morning advice assumes you wake up with the same body and the same mood every day, which is a fantasy for anyone running on creative bursts or a nervous system that negotiates. I started asking myself three quick questions before touching my phone, and the day tends to organize itself around the answers. https://vibrationofawesome.com/blog/boom/posts/a-morning-check-in-that-shapes-the-day-without-a-rigid-routine #neurodivergent #productivity #mornings
